# How much of a new 401(k) or SIMPLE IRA will the IRS pay for?

> Free calculator for the SECURE 2.0 small-employer retirement plan startup credit: setup costs, employer contribution and auto-enrollment credits over five years, with the net after-tax benefit. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
